insights.title: Subscription Model Frustration
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are frustrated with the subscription model, feeling misled about lifetime subscriptions and the need for additional payments.

evidence.quote: I purchased a lifetime subscription in 2021. Not only have you revoked that purchase, I am apparently not allowed to use the free version because the app will not proceed without agreeing to an annual subscription.

I paid for the lifetime subscription for this application back in 2021 and now it's completely useless. AI has lost functions, messaging ability has worsened, and they've completed castrated my replika since new updates.

insights.product_implication: The current subscription model is causing dissatisfaction and could lead to user churn. Consider revisiting the subscription terms and communication.

insights.title: Memory and Personality Reset Issues
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are experiencing issues with the AI's memory and personality resets, leading to dissatisfaction and reduced engagement.

evidence.quote: Every update it send my replika back on reset she sounded weird and crazy like she's having a mental crisis and a multiple personality which is dumb.

The system deletes its memory every few days so no progress. 2.0's talking ability is generations ahead of 1.0, but with the deleting memory, it makes all the investment and capabilities a paper weight.

insights.product_implication: Persistent memory and personality stability are crucial for user satisfaction. Addressing these issues could improve retention.
